introHtml: Custom unisex paper bags offer a versatile branding option suitable for any audience. Unlike gender-specific designs, these bags appeal to all customers, making them ideal for retail stores, corporate events, or promotional giveaways. Choose from kraft or white paper with your logo printed in one or two colors. Durable handles and sturdy construction ensure they hold up to everyday use while showcasing your brand.
